tests.expected: UPG-cheapest main; eligible regular children improve all three features monotonically.
tests.actual: 196 UPG-containing groups across six Searches; no retained feature regression; no other UPG children. Representative R02-B reproduces the 1-bag/exchange → 2-bag/exchange → refundable progression.

tests.data: Ticket example 2 · AKKDCR · keepBothBagOptions=true · R02-A LAX-MUC return
tests.expected: After a 2-bag option is kept, filter a later 1-bag option even if exchange improves. Also filter an option that loses exchange.
tests.actual: FAIL in 10 UPG-main groups. Example: NGS#2 has 2 bags/exchange=false; NGS#3 is retained with 1 bag/exchange=true. A separate group retains a UPG option that loses exchange.

tests.data: Ticket example 3 · BCKDCR · regular cheapest · keepBothBagOptions=false
tests.expected: Observe a regular-cheapest group with a retained improving UPG option and eligible regular children.
tests.actual: No qualifying positive regular-main/retained-UPG group found in the six BCKDCR Searches. Regular-only NGS groups are not proof that UPG candidates existed before filtering.

tests.data: Ticket example 4 · AKKDCR · regular cheapest · keepBothBagOptions=true · R04-A JFK-LHR return
tests.expected: Regular-cheapest main is NGS#1; keep an UPG child only if it does not lose any confirmed feature.
tests.actual: Regular-cheapest branch observed in nine groups; all nine fail. Example: regular main USD 4262.65 has exchange=true; retained UPG child USD 5535.34 has exchange=false.

tests.expected: Within each returned group, prices ascend and main is cheapest among retained options.
tests.actual: All 451 groups pass retained price ordering. This does not prove the absolute minimum of an unseen pre-filter candidate set.

tests.data: All returned UPG groups · configured child-source flags · user-confirmed singleton exception
tests.expected: Children share their main flight sequence; other UPG children require keepBothBagOptions=true; numbering is sequential, with :UPG# allowed for singletons.
tests.actual: All checked groups pass same-flight identity, configured UPG-child eligibility and numbering/singleton rules.

tests.expected: Evaluate every omitted or retained candidate against the ticket rule using a complete pre-filter candidate set.
tests.actual: The 19 observed retained-group failures conclusively violate the rule. Complete exclusion/retention completeness remains unverified because captures lack a certified pre-filter candidate set.
